title: Concept for a Community Discord Hub?
author: TheUniverseOrNothing
selftext:
This is just a prototype I put together. I am trying to think of ways to turn my discord server into a community hub.

The idea behind this is everyone will claim a room and display their builds/games. It’s just a fancy way to display your work and encourage others to leave feedback.

I’m open to any suggestions or ideas. I just started building this and I’m exploring the idea as I go. I want to get more creative with it and allow members more freedom and customization, just not sure what direction to take it.

comments.author: United-Tour5043
comments.body: THIS IS CUTTIND EDGE. THE INTERNET SHOULD BE LIKE THIS

replies.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
replies.body:
The internet is so hostile I can’t tell if you are serious or joking.

I remember during the nft phase I think it was called sandbox was trying to sell digital real estate. I always thought that concept was cool just horribly executed and too early for the metaverse.

With this my idea is it just helps organize the wall of text with 50 other people sharing their builds. And instead of selling nfts or digital real estate, the users actually going around and trying other devs games and leaving feedback could be rewarded with a better room position

comments.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
comments.body:
I’m upgrading the rooms and how it displays everyone’s projects right now. I already have the backend on supabase and a cloudflare bot connected to discord. I literally just posted this in my discord so once more users sign up I’ll be able to get more info on what we need to upgrade.

I also manage a marketing business and have other side games I’m working on so my bandwidth has been very limited. But if an idea seems cool enough I will get hyper focused and spend my entire 20x usage limits making this better ha.
